name: Chapter 227. Administrative procedure and review
scope: chapter Wis. Stat. ch. 227 (Legislative Reference Bureau, chapter pages)

notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person
notice.quote: If the agency denies the petition, it shall promptly notify the person who filed the petition of its decision, including a brief statement of the reasons therefor.

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final
hearing.quote_through: An agency that proposes to rely on a guidance document to the detriment of a person in any proceeding shall afford the person an adequate opportunity to contest the legality or wisdom of a position taken in the guidance document.

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer
appeal.quote_through: If the individual, small nonprofit corporation or small business is the prevailing party in the proceeding for judicial review, the court shall make the findings applicable under s.

access.label: The person can see the record
access.quote_through: An agency, upon request, shall make available to the public at no cost a copy of any proposed rule, including the analysis, fiscal estimate and any related form.

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire
waiver.quote: (5) A statement of scope shall expire on the date that is 30 months after the date on which it is published in the register.

symmetry.label: Binds individuals harder than institutions
symmetry.qe: If the committee suspends an emergency rule under this section, the agency may not submit to the legislature under s.

boundary.label: What it takes from you, and the limits on that
boundary.quote_limits: An agency may not use a guidance document to foreclose consideration of any issue raised in the guidance document.
